sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Vibrant Pink Enamel Tulip Gold Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Brighten her day with this vibrant pink enamel tulip bracelet. Featuring a high-shine "dripping oil" finish and lush green leaves, this elegant gold-toned chain is a meaningful gift for Mom. Durable and versatile, it's a perfect floral accessory for Mother's Day or daily wear
